# 大乘大集地藏十輪經

**ID:** T0411
**Volume:** T13
**Category:** 大集部類
**Original Category:** 大集部
**Byline:** 唐 玄奘譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 651
**Juans:** 10
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0411

## Contributors
- 玄奘 (A000294)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Dàshèng dàjí dìzàng shílún jīng* in 10 fascicles is [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng's mid-Táng retranslation of the *Daśacakra-kṣitigarbha-sūtra* — the principal sūtra of the [地藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E8%97%8F) Kṣitigarbha cult. The Taishō print signs the entry "三藏法師玄奘奉詔譯" and explicitly cross-references *No. 410* — the older anonymous translation [KR6h0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0014). Xuánzàng's version became the canonical text of the *Shílún jīng* in the East Asian tradition and largely displaced the older Northern-Liáng anonymous version in subsequent doctrinal and devotional usage.

**Abstract**

The translation is precisely datable. According to [圓測](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%B8%AC) Wǒnch'ǔk's *[Jiě shēnmì jīng shū 解深密經疏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0058)* and the standard biographical account of [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) in the *[Dà cí'ēnsì sānzàng fǎshī zhuàn 大慈恩寺三藏法師傳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6r/KR6r0007)* (T2053, j. 7), the *Shílún jīng* was rendered at the *Dàcí'ēn* 大慈恩 monastery in Cháng'ān in Yǒnghuī 永徽 2 (651), shortly after Xuánzàng's return from India and roughly contemporary with his translation of the *Saṃdhinirmocana* (T676) and other middle-period works of his enterprise. The frontmatter date 651 reflects this single-year completion.

The text is the fullest Chinese version of the *Daśacakra-kṣitigarbha-sūtra*. Its 10 chapters (序品, 十輪品, 無依行品, 有依行品, 懺悔品, 善業道品, 福田相品, 獲益囑累品, 念佛三昧品 etc.) systematically expound the doctrine of the *Ten Wheels* of Kṣitigarbha's protective dispensation; Xuánzàng's translation idiom — markedly more literal and Sanskritising than the older anonymous version — became the basis for [圓測](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%B8%AC) Wǒnch'ǔk's commentary and the standard understanding of Kṣitigarbha doctrine in the Táng Yogācāra tradition. With *[the Dìzàng púsà běnyuàn jīng (T0412)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0016)*, it constitutes the principal canonical foundation of the Chinese, Korean, and Japanese Kṣitigarbha cults; the *Dìzàng* 地藏 / Jizō devotional culture of medieval East Asia is grounded in these two sūtras.
